names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 27 octombrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Nestor».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 27 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιος Νέστωρ», with the rank word left off.

Read whole off the title on the name link behind his line for 27 октября ст. ст., «Нестор Солунский (Фессалоникийский), мч.», with the rank word left off; the bracketed second form of the city is the calendar's own. The line on the day page declines the name and gives only the first form.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 27. октобар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Нестор.“ — «Св.» is "saint" and not a rank and «муч.» is the `martyr` grade this corpus keeps in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name is the whole of the form. The heading gives no by-name and no city: «у Солуну», which is what the folder’s display name is built on, is the body’s first sentence. The next entry on the same day does carry a by-name, «Летописац», and that is what keeps the two Nestors of this day apart. `foldchk.py` finds this string on `nestor-of-maghid`, so the form joins a fold of two, keyed in `READ_FOLDS` in the same commit.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 октября ст. ст. — «Мч. Нестора Солунского (ок. 306).»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Νέστωρ»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2660/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man: the very young friend of Demetrius who killed the gladiator Lyaios in the stadium at Thessalonica and was run through with a spear for it. Its heading prints «(; - 306)», so a `dates` object with the death year alone is proposed; the narrative names Diocletian and no year. Demetrius is cross-referenced to 26 Οκτωβρίου and has a folder, so he is linked and gets a `related` row. Relics are listed at Iviron and Zographou on Athos, at Agia Lavra of Kalavryta, Zavorda in Grevena and Kykkos in Cyprus, and at the Alexander Nevsky Lavra in Saint Petersburg; no coordinate is proposed. Its Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’, and its Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, both name him and are taken; the Οἶκος, which also names him, is not a kind the schema holds. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 09.11.2025 (27. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Нестор.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, one person, quoted whole with the closing full stop the Prologue prints (BRIEF-SERBIAN section 4). «муч.» is the `martyr` this folder already holds, so `types` is untouched. TWO NESTORS ON ONE DAY, AND THE HEADINGS DO NOT TELL THEM APART — THE BODIES DO. This heading is bare, «Св. муч. Нестор.», and entry 2 is «Преп. Нестор Летописац». What settles entry 1 on this folder is its own first sentence: «У време страдања св. Димитрија Мироточивог беше у Солуну неки младић Нестор, који се научи вери Христовој од самог св. Димитрија» — in the time of the suffering of Demetrius the Myrrh-streamer there was at Thessalonica a youth named Nestor who learned the faith of Christ from Demetrius himself. That is this folder and no other, and the corpus’s third Nestor, `nestor-the-unlearned`, is on the Russian 27 October and the Greek 29 October and is neither of these two. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND THE BOOK AGREES EXACTLY. The folder holds `death` 306, whose `note` says saint.gr heads him «(; - 306)» while giving no year in its narrative. This entry closes «Тако сконча свој млади земаљски живот овај славни хришћански јунак Нестор, 306. год.» — the same year, printed in the narrative instead of in a heading, which CONFIRMS the folder’s only date rather than moving it. Nothing was changed, and the confirmation is the point: the Greek page’s year was a bracket and this one is a sentence. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. Lyaeus’s scaffold described as a threshing floor on pillars with the sharpened spears planted point-upward beneath it, so that a beaten man was pushed off the top into a whole forest of them and the heathen crowd watched him writhe until he died. CHRISTIANS WERE DRAGGED TO THE FIGHT BY FORCE, on the emperor’s own order, whenever nobody volunteered — which is the Prologue’s explanation of why Nestor acted, and is on neither of this folder’s other pages in that form. The blessing in the prison is given as a prophecy in two halves: «Лија ћеш победити, али ћеш за Христа пострадати.» — thou shalt overcome Lyaeus, but thou shalt suffer for Christ. Nestor’s own cry is «Боже Димитријев, помози ми!», and the crowd’s answer after the throw is «велики је Бог Димитријев!» — the god of Demetrius is great. And the sentence passed on the two men is one sentence: Nestor cut down with the sword, Demetrius run through with spears. NO NEW `related`. `demetrius-the-myrrhstreamer` is already related both ways and is linked in this folder’s life. Лије, the Vandal gladiator, and Максимијан are narrated and in no heading, so Ruling 3 and section 5 give them nothing, and no folder read here holds either. No `locations`, no `office`. THE FORM FOLDS AND THE FOLD IS KEYED. «Нестор» is already held by `nestor-of-maghid`, the hieromartyr bishop this same book keeps on the Julian 28 February, so this form takes the key from one holder to two; `sr-foldpred.mjs` named him before the write and a `READ_FOLDS` key goes in with this commit. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne Nestor, întru nevoința sa, cununa nestricăciunii a dobândit de la tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că, având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a și ale demonilor neputinciose îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuiește sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Nestor, Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyr Nestor, O Lord, in his contest received an incorruptible crown from Thee our God; for possessing Thy strength he overthrew his torturers, and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By his prayers save Thou our souls, O Christ God.

hymns.text: Ἀθλητὴς εὐσεβείας ἀκαταγώνιστος, ὡς κοινωνὸς καὶ συνήθης τοῦ Δημητρίου ὀφθεῖς, ἠγωνίσω ἀνδρικῶς Νέστωρ μακάριε, τὴ θεϊκὴ γὰρ ἀρωγή, τὸν Λυαῖον καθελῶν, ὡς ἄμωμον ἱερεῖον, σφαγιασθεὶς προσηνέχθης, τῷ Ἀθλοθέτῃ καὶ Θεῶ ἠμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, «Άγιος Νέστωρ» — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’. Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον

english.text: An unconquered contestant of godliness, shown to be the companion and familiar friend of Demetrius, you struggled manfully, blessed Nestor; for by divine help you pulled down Lyaios, and being slaughtered you were offered up like a spotless victim to the Giver of the prize and our God.

hymns.text: Ἀθλήσας καλῶς, ἀθάνατον τὴν εὔκλειαν, κεκλήρωσαι νῦν· καὶ στρατιώτης ἄριστος, τοῦ Δεσπότου γέγονας, ταῖς εὐχαῖς Δημητρίου τοῦ Μάρτυρος. Σὺν αὐτῷ οὖν Νέστορ σοφέ, πρεσβεύων μὴ παύσῃ ὑπὲρ πάντων ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, «Άγιος Νέστωρ» — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’. Τὰ ἄνω ζητῶν

english.text: Having contended well, you have now inherited immortal renown, and have become the Master's best soldier by the prayers of Demetrius the martyr. With him, then, wise Nestor, do not cease to intercede for us all.

hymns.text: Мученик Твой, Господи, Нестор/ во страдании своем венец прият нетленный от Тебе, Бога нашего,/ имеяй бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложи,/ сокруши и демонов немощныя дерзости:/ того молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мученика Нестора»

english.text: Your martyr Nestor, O Lord, in his suffering received an incorruptible crown from you, our God; for having your strength he threw down his persecutors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. By his prayers save our souls.

hymns.text: Страдальчествовав добре,/ безсмертную славу наследовал еси ныне,/ яко воин изрядный Владыки был еси,/ молитвами Димитрия мученика:/ с ним убо, Несторе мудре,// моля не престай о всех нас.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак мученика Нестора»

english.text: Having borne the contest well, you have now inherited undying glory, for you were an excellent soldier of the Master, by the prayers of the martyr Demetrius. With him, then, wise Nestor, do not cease praying for us all.

hymns.text: Благочестия непобедимаго воина/ и истине согласника и оружника/ вси по достоянию восхвалим Нестора великаго днесь/ и к нему возопием:/ моли Христа Бога о всех нас.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 октября ст. ст. — «Ин кондак мученика Нестора Солунского»

english.text: The unconquerable soldier of piety, the fellow and the armour-bearer of the truth — let us all worthily praise the great Nestor today, and cry out to him: pray to Christ God for us all.

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Αγιος Νεστωρ (; - 306)»; the narrative gives no year and names only the emperor Diocletian.
